title: CME Globex Notice: 1Gbps connections to lose MDP 3.0 multicast market data
summary: Effective 2026-06-27, 1Gbps services no longer carry MDP 3.0 multicast market data; affected customers must upgrade to 10Gbps. Unicast services (iLink, Drop Copy, STP, MQ) stay on 1Gbps. Re-announced in successive weekly notices.
